details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) Pipeline phase workflows: clarify, plan, implement or review/autofix (`.github/workflows/*.yml` plus their `scripts/` helpers)
B) The orchestrator: poller, judge, integration-sync, stall recovery
C) Validation or the AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`)
D) Documentation only: README, `docs/`, `agents.d/` fragments
E) Something else: name the file, workflow or feature in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: give a run ID, PR number or log line (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or runtime: fewer tokens, GitHub API calls or workflow minutes
C) Make it more reliable: fewer flaky failures or stalls, better retries
D) Add a new capability: describe the behavior you want
E) Make it clearer: better docs, log messages or operator notes
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A specific failing scenario or run now succeeds, and a contract test pins it (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable metric improves: give the metric and the target
C) A described behavior is present and documented
D) Other: describe it in your `/answer`
